What is the measure of $∠G$ in the triangle $△FGH$ above?
question.worked_solution:
Since two sides are congruent, $\overset{―}{FG}≅\overset{―}{GH},$ we conclude that $△FGH$ is isosceles. Consequently, the base angles must have the same measure:

$$
m∠F=m∠H=x+{13}^{∘}
$$

Now, since the internal angles of any triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠F+m∠G+m∠H & ={180}^{∘} \\ (x+{13}^{∘})+(2x+{18}^{∘})+(x+{13}^{∘}) & ={180}^{∘} \\ 4x+{44}^{∘} & ={180}^{∘} \\ 4x & ={136}^{∘} \\ x & ={34}^{∘}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $x={34}^{∘}$ into the equation for the measure of $∠G$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠G & =2x+{18}^{∘} \\  & =2({34}^{∘})+{18}^{∘} \\  & ={86}^{∘}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

So $m∠G={86}^{∘}.$
